reason: C3 is the most specific and well-defined hypothesis, proposing a concrete intervention (applying a thin, continuous, and adherent alumina coating) with a clear mechanism (the alumina coating acts as a barrier to oxygen diffusion) that is specific to the HfNbTaTiZr alloy system. It also provides quantified predictions (maintaining yield strength above 163 MPa and tensile ductility above 8% at 1000 °C) and a decisive falsification test (controlled oxidation test with measurements of weight gain, yield strength, and tensile ductility). Additionally, C3 has a clear and specific structural mediator (the alumina coating) and boundary conditions (temperature, atmosphere, exposure time, and mechanical loading), making it a more robust and testable hypothesis compared to the other candidates.
